name: Microsoft Azure logo
notes: Azure 'A' mark (2021 design). Commons credits Microsoft Corporation / azure.microsoft.com and marks it public domain. Symbol only, no wordmark.

name: Azure AI Foundry
notes: The package calls it 'AI Foundry'. The older 'AI Studio' icon (03513-icon-service-AI-Studio.svg) is also in the package but not used. There are also Foundry sub-product icons (Foundry Agent Service, Foundry Models and others).

name: Azure AI Document Intelligence
notes: The package still calls it 'Form Recognizers' (the former name of Document Intelligence).

name: Azure AI services
notes: The package calls it 'Cognitive Services' (the former name). The package has no icon named 'AI services'. An identical copy is in the web/ folder.

name: Azure Container Apps
notes: Judgment call. V24 has no icon named exactly 'Container Apps'. This 'Worker Container App' icon (purple containers with a cyan orbit) is the design commonly used for Azure Container Apps. The alternative, other/02989-icon-service-Container-Apps-Environments.svg, is for the Environment resource (not used).

name: Azure Machine Learning
notes: The newer Azure Machine Learning icon (purple tri-shape). The legacy blue flask icon is also in the package (10166-icon-service-Machine-Learning.svg) but not used.
